overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 22 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Can China’s dancing robots swing some new business partners in Africa?
featured.summary: At events marking China’s National Day in Africa on October 1, robots provided the entertainment. In Luanda, Angola, dancing robots amused guests and ambassador Zhang Bin called the industry “a small snapshot of the Chinese economy’s move towards innovation and higher-quality development”. In Brazzaville, Congo, nearly 400 guests – including Congolese officials and Chinese business representatives – watched on as a robot dog performed. Guests also interacted with a robot dog at a Chinese New...
featured.titleZh: 中国的跳舞机器人能否在非洲开拓新商机？
featured.summaryZh: 在非洲举行的中国国庆庆祝活动中，跳舞机器人和机器狗成为焦点，展示了中国制造业的创新成果。中国外交官借此强调了中国经济向高质量发展转型的趋势。
featured.whyImportant: 通过科技展示，中国正试图在非洲市场推广其高科技产品并加强双边经贸合作。

featured.title: 127 arrested as Hong Kong police bust Vietnamese-led loan-sharking syndicate
featured.summary: Hong Kong police have arrested 127 people in a six-month undercover operation against a Vietnamese-led crime syndicate accused of running loan-sharking rackets charging interest rates of up to 3,700 per cent, as well as illegal gambling and unlicensed bars in West Kowloon. The syndicate is also alleged to have helped illegal immigrants find shelter and work, with police raiding eight premises on October 8 and 9. Among those arrested were 10 alleged core members, including the suspected leader, a...
featured.titleZh: 香港警方破获越南裔高利贷团伙，127人被捕
featured.summaryZh: 香港警方经过六个月的卧底行动，捣毁了一个由越南裔主导的犯罪团伙。该团伙涉嫌经营高利贷、非法赌博及无牌酒吧，并协助非法移民寻找住所和工作。
featured.whyImportant: 此次大规模执法行动有效打击了涉及非法移民及高利贷的跨境犯罪活动，维护了社区治安。

global.title: Twelve killed and 300 injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
global.summary: Donald Trump evaluating whether US should join Saudi strikes against the Iran-backed Yemeni rebels The latest attack on the international airport in Saudi Arabia’s capital of Riyadh killed 12 people and injured more than 300 others, civil aviation authorities said early Sunday, with some in a critical condition. A Saudi-led coalition blamed Iran-backed Houthi rebels in neighbouring Yemen. A missile struck a King Khalid international airport complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights, a regional official said, speaking on condition of anonymity because they weren’t authorised to speak to the media. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 沙特首都利雅得机场遭袭，造成12人死亡、300人受伤
global.summaryZh: 沙特首都利雅得的哈立德国王国际机场遭到导弹袭击，导致12人死亡，300多人受伤，部分伤者情况危急。沙特领导的联军指责也门胡塞武装发动了此次袭击。
global.whyImportant: 此次袭击加剧了沙特与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势，并引发了关于美国是否应介入冲突的讨论。

global.title: Ben Roberts-Smith attends Canberra event honouring Australian troops who served in Afghanistan
global.summary: Anthony Albanese speaks at Australian War Memorial event commemorating 25th anniversary of country’s involvement in the conflict Anthony Albanese has honoured Australian troops who served in Afghanistan, using the 25th anniversary of the country’s involvement in the conflict to describe their heroism as a fight for “who we are as a people”. The prime minister joined hundreds of veterans, family members and dignitaries at a commemoration of the start of the campaign in Canberra on Sunday, with nation’s most decorated living soldier and accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith among the crowd at the Australian War Memorial. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 本·罗伯茨-史密斯出席堪培拉活动，纪念在阿富汗服役的澳大利亚军队
global.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯在堪培拉举行的纪念活动上，向在阿富汗服役的澳大利亚士兵致敬，称赞他们的英勇表现。备受争议的退伍军人本·罗伯茨-史密斯也出席了此次纪念澳大利亚参与该冲突25周年的活动。
global.whyImportant: 该活动旨在纪念澳大利亚的军事历史，但因涉嫌战争罪的罗伯茨-史密斯的出席而引发了公众关注。

global.title: Hurricane Isaias kills four, leaves 650,000 without power in Florida
global.summary: Four people died after Hurricane Isaias made landfall early on Saturday, and about 670,000 residents in Florida, Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi were still without power as the storm weakened to a post-tropical cyclone, according to local authorities and electricity monitoring services. Two of the deaths resulted ‌from trees falling on homes, according to local media and authorities. Authorities in Florida had received no search and rescue requests shortly after landfall in a sign of limited...
global.titleZh: 飓风“伊萨亚斯”造成4人死亡，佛罗里达州65万人断电
global.summaryZh: 飓风“伊萨亚斯”登陆后已减弱为后热带气旋，但仍造成4人死亡。佛罗里达州及周边地区约67万人受灾断电，部分死亡事故由树木倒塌引发。
global.whyImportant: 此次飓风对美国东南部基础设施造成了严重破坏，并引发了对灾后救援和电力恢复的关注。

global.title: Who rules Negeri Sembilan? Royal row tests Malaysia’s constitutional order
global.summary: The dust has yet to settle in Malaysia’s Negeri Sembilan, where a royal row has led to the fall of a state government and left the public wondering who, exactly, is in charge. Observers warn that the months-long constitutional crisis could create ripple effects well beyond the state’s borders, testing the entire nation’s systems of monarchy and government. The dispute centres on which of two men: the incumbent, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir, or his intended replacement, Tunku Nadzaruddin Tuanku...
global.titleZh: 谁在统治森美兰州？王室纠纷考验马来西亚宪政秩序
global.summaryZh: 马来西亚森美兰州因王室内部纠纷导致州政府倒台，引发了关于谁拥有实际统治权的宪政危机。观察人士警告，这场争端可能对马来西亚的君主立宪制度产生深远影响。
global.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了马来西亚地方政治与王室权力之间的潜在冲突，对国家的宪政稳定性构成了挑战。

global.title: Two Carlton players treated in hospital after needing care for ‘separate circumstances’
global.summary: Club issues brief statement about Lachie Cowan and Will Hayward, saying latter suffered minor cut to head after a fall Carlton football club has said two of its players, Lachie Cowan and Will Hayward, required treatment in hospital on Sunday morning in “separate circumstances”. The club released a statement on Sunday after reports in several media outlets that unnamed players had been taken to hospital by ambulance after a night out. Guardian Australia contacted Carlton seeking comment on the reports. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 两名卡尔顿队球员因“不同情况”在医院接受治疗
global.summaryZh: 卡尔顿足球俱乐部证实，球员拉奇·考恩和威尔·海沃德因不同原因在周日早晨入院治疗。俱乐部回应了关于球员在夜间外出后被送往医院的媒体报道，并确认海沃德因跌倒导致头部轻微割伤。
global.whyImportant: 作为职业体育俱乐部，球员的健康状况和场外行为受到公众和媒体的密切关注。

global.title: Christian nationalism in Britain driven by people who seldom go to church, says report
global.summary: Research challenges the notion that the growing visibility of crosses and other symbols reflects a revival of Christianity Christian nationalism in Britain is being driven largely by people who rarely attend church and are more concerned with defending the country’s Christian heritage, according to research. The report, by the thinktank Theos, identified five different groups within the UK in a survey that looked at their attitudes to Christianity and Britishness. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 报告称英国的基督教民族主义主要由极少去教堂的人推动
global.summaryZh: 智库Theos的一项研究指出，英国基督教民族主义的抬头并非源于宗教复兴，而是由那些很少参加教会活动、更关注捍卫国家基督教传统的人所驱动。研究识别了英国社会中对基督教和英国身份认同持不同态度的五个群体。
global.whyImportant: 该研究挑战了关于宗教符号可见度增加即代表宗教信仰复兴的传统观点，揭示了文化身份认同在现代政治中的作用。

global.title: Capital punishment is surging in the US – but after Christa Pike’s botched execution, what is its future?
global.summary: Trump has used the full might of the presidency to supercharge executions, but an avalanche of mishaps has put the system’s flaws in the spotlight It took more than an hour to establish the two intravenous lines through which Christa Pike would be injected with a giant and normally lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital, and in that time she did everything she could to assist those who were attempting to kill her. “Please try here,” she said over and over again to Tennessee’s execution team, pointing to specific parts of her body where she thought they might find a vein as they repeatedly stabbed her with needles. “Please try here, I think it will be OK. Please try up on my shoulder, higher.” Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 美国死刑执行激增，但在克里斯塔·派克执行失败后，其未来何去何从？
global.summaryZh: 尽管美国政府近期加大了死刑执行力度，但克里斯塔·派克在执行过程中遭遇的严重失误引发了对死刑制度缺陷的质疑。执行团队在寻找静脉注射点时多次失败，导致过程极其痛苦且漫长。
global.whyImportant: 执行过程中的失误再次引发了关于死刑人道性及制度合理性的激烈社会辩论。

global.title: How a museum masterpiece’s life-size replica sparked rare US-China collaboration
global.summary: For anyone who has visited the Chinese galleries at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, there is one work that stops them in their tracks. Stepping into Gallery 206, home to Chinese Buddhist art, visitors are met by a monumental wall – over 15 metres wide and 7.5 metres tall (nearly 50 feet by 25 feet) – covered in a Buddhist assembly so vast and majestic that it momentarily erases the Manhattan bustle outside. Here stands the Medicine Buddha, a 14th century Yuan dynasty (1279-1368)...
global.titleZh: 博物馆杰作的等身复制品如何促成美中罕见合作
global.summaryZh: 纽约大都会艺术博物馆收藏的元代药师佛壁画因其宏伟壮观而备受瞩目。为了展示这一杰作，博物馆通过与中国的合作，制作了等身复制品，促进了文化交流。
global.whyImportant: 这一合作项目展示了通过艺术保护和复制技术，美中两国在文化遗产领域可以实现积极的互动与交流。

global.title: Unsung turtle conservation heroes in Malaysia’s Sabah unite to fight poachers
global.summary: Roziah Jelali has a tip or two on catching a turtle poacher: carrying a pair of binoculars and having patience in spades are key to doing the job well. The 36-year-old Malaysian volunteer ranger once spent three months in Sabah tracking a man whom she suspected of illegally capturing protected turtles. Once thriving off the azure seas of Omadal Island in the Malaysian state, many turtles had been hunted down, killed and sold for their meat, according to conservation experts. Recounting the 2023...
global.titleZh: 马来西亚沙巴州的无名海龟保护英雄联合打击偷猎者
global.summaryZh: 马来西亚沙巴州的志愿者们通过耐心蹲守和观察，积极打击非法捕杀受保护海龟的偷猎者。当地海龟曾因被猎杀用于肉类贸易而数量锐减，保护工作对生态恢复至关重要。
global.whyImportant: 民间志愿者的参与对于保护濒危物种及维护当地海洋生态平衡具有积极意义。

china.title: Nanotechnology expert Antonio Facchetti joins HKUST from Georgia Tech in the US
china.summary: Materials scientist and chemist Antonio Facchetti, formerly of the Georgia Institute of Technology in the United States, has joined the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as a chair professor in its newly established department of materials. Facchetti, who was elected to the US National Academy of Engineering last year for his “contributions to the engineering of commercially viable electronic materials and devices”, researches semiconductors, dielectrics for thin-film and...
china.titleZh: 纳米技术专家安东尼奥·法切蒂从美国佐治亚理工学院加入香港科技大学
china.summaryZh: 美国国家工程院院士、材料科学家安东尼奥·法切蒂已加入香港科技大学，担任新成立的材料系讲座教授。他此前在电子材料和器件工程领域贡献卓著，未来将致力于相关科研工作。
china.whyImportant: 顶尖科研人才的引进有助于提升香港在材料科学领域的国际学术地位与创新能力。

china.title: Huanggang Port a ‘milestone’ for integrating Hong Kong, Greater Bay Area: John Lee
china.summary: The revamped Huanggang checkpoint is a “critical milestone” for the connectivity of the Greater Bay Area, Hong Kong’s leader has said, as the city and Shenzhen count down to its launch on Monday. Speaking at a ceremony on Sunday, Chief Executive John Lee-Ka Chiu said the Huanggang control point was a “landmark project” built and shared through the joint efforts of Hong Kong and Shenzhen. “Hong Kong unveiled its first five-year plan last month to proactively align with the national 15th five-year...
china.titleZh: 李家超：皇岗口岸是香港融入大湾区的里程碑
china.summaryZh: 香港特区行政长官李家超表示，即将启用的皇岗口岸是深港合作的标志性项目，对大湾区互联互通具有重要意义。此举旨在配合国家五年规划，进一步深化区域融合。
china.whyImportant: 新口岸的启用将显著提升深港两地的交通效率，促进大湾区内的人员与经济流动。

china.title: Paul Chan highlights 4 priorities ahead of Apec finance ministers’ meeting this month
china.summary: The Apec finance ministers’ meeting in Hong Kong this month will focus on fiscal policies that support livelihoods, digital infrastructure financing, inclusive finance and young financial talent, underlining the city’s role as an international financial centre, the finance chief said. “These four priorities are areas of strength for Hong Kong and fields in which we can make an active contribution,” Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po wrote in his weekly blog on Sunday. “Hosting the finance...
china.titleZh: 陈茂波强调本月亚太经合组织财长会议的四大优先事项
china.summaryZh: 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，即将举行的亚太经合组织财长会议将聚焦民生财政政策、数字基础设施融资、普惠金融及青年金融人才培养。他强调这些领域是香港的优势所在。
china.whyImportant: 作为东道主，香港通过设定会议议程展示了其作为国际金融中心的专业影响力。

china.title: Admission scores fall for Hong Kong physiotherapy courses amid jobs crunch
china.summary: Admission scores for physiotherapy degree programmes at three Hong Kong tertiary institutions fell by as much as 10 per cent this year compared with 2025, amid gloomy career prospects in the sector, the latest data shows. The decline prompted the professional body for physiotherapists to call on the government to halt healthcare funding cuts in the next budget, saying they had contributed to a jobs crunch in the sector. Across four institutions, 23 per cent of students admitted to physiotherapy...
china.titleZh: 受就业市场紧缩影响，香港物理治疗课程录取分数下降
china.summaryZh: 数据显示，香港三所高校的物理治疗学位课程录取分数较去年下降了10%。专业团体指出，医疗资金削减导致行业就业困难，呼吁政府在预算中予以重视。
china.whyImportant: 教育录取门槛的变化反映了相关行业就业前景的波动，引发了对医疗人才培养政策的讨论。

usa.title: Denuclearising North Korea would ‘defy history’ as US, allies missed the boat
usa.summary: The denuclearisation of North Korea has become an “increasingly improbable” goal and the United States and its allies should move beyond it to devote their diplomatic efforts to talks on arms limitations and crisis communication, the director of the US-based North Korean analysis website 38 North said. Recalling the 20 years since North Korea carried out its first nuclear test on October 9, 2006, Jenny Town said in a written interview that “a pivotal moment” in Pyongyang’s weapons development...
usa.titleZh: 专家称朝鲜无核化已“违背历史”，美及其盟友应转向军控谈判
usa.summaryZh: 美国智库专家指出，朝鲜无核化目标已变得极难实现，建议美国及其盟友将外交重点转向军备限制和危机沟通。朝鲜自2006年首次核试验以来，其武器开发已进入新阶段。
usa.whyImportant: 该观点挑战了传统的对朝政策，反映了国际社会对朝鲜半岛局势长期僵持的担忧。

usa.title: US opens antitrust probe into TV networks halting Trump coverage

usa.titleZh: 美国对电视网络中断特朗普报道的行为展开反垄断调查
usa.summaryZh: 美国司法部表示，正在调查白宫记者团中断特朗普报道的决定是否违反了反垄断法。该调查旨在评估媒体机构的行为是否涉及不正当竞争。
usa.whyImportant: 此举引发了关于媒体独立性与政府监管权力边界的广泛讨论。

usa.title: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago - why are they resuming now?
usa.summary: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed, but experts suggest officials are reading the country wrong.
usa.titleZh: 美国公开处决已停止近一个世纪，为何现在恢复？
usa.summaryZh: 五角大楼宣布将直播胡德堡枪击案凶手尼达尔·哈桑的处决过程。专家认为，政府此举可能误判了公众对恢复公开处决的接受程度。
usa.whyImportant: 这一决定挑战了美国长期以来的司法伦理标准，引发了关于刑事司法透明度与人权的争议。

usa.title: How the trial of murdered Australian brothers and US friend unfolded
usa.summary: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".
usa.titleZh: 两名澳大利亚兄弟及其美国朋友遇害案的审判过程回顾
usa.summaryZh: 两年前在墨西哥遇害的两名澳大利亚冲浪者及其美国朋友的母亲表示，追究责任至关重要。该案件的审判过程引发了国际社会对跨国犯罪司法公正的关注。
usa.whyImportant: 该案件凸显了在处理跨国暴力犯罪时，受害者家属对司法问责的迫切诉求。

watch.title: US forces disable ship ‘attempting to run’ Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman
watch.summary: US military jet strikes stern of commercial cargo ship 'without harming the crew', CENTCOM says.
watch.titleZh: 美军在阿曼湾拦截一艘“试图突破”伊朗封锁的船只
watch.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部表示，美军战机对一艘商用货船的船尾进行了打击，并未造成船员伤亡。该船被指试图突破伊朗的封锁线。
watch.whyImportant: 此事件加剧了波斯湾地区的紧张局势，并引发了对海上航行安全与地缘政治冲突的担忧。

watch.title: Japan’s Sumitomo Bakelite expands China chip packaging materials output amid AI boom
watch.summary: Japanese semiconductor materials giant Sumitomo Bakelite plans to expand production of advanced chip packaging materials in China and Singapore, marking the second such announcement for its Chinese operations in less than four months as artificial intelligence drives demand for more sophisticated semiconductors. The Tokyo-based company said on Friday that it would add production lines for mould underfill (MUF) materials and compression-moulding granules at its facilities in Suzhou, eastern...
watch.titleZh: 受人工智能热潮推动，日本住友电木扩大在华芯片封装材料产能
watch.summaryZh: 日本半导体材料巨头住友电木计划扩大其在中国和新加坡的先进芯片封装材料生产。这是该公司四个月内第二次宣布扩大在华业务，以满足人工智能领域对高性能半导体的需求。
watch.whyImportant: 此举反映了全球半导体供应链在人工智能驱动下，正持续向中国市场进行产能布局。

watch.title: Yemen’s Houthis release video of drone attacks on gov’t forces
watch.summary: Yemen’s Houthis have released drone video said to show attacks on Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.
watch.titleZh: 也门胡塞武装发布针对政府军的无人机袭击视频
watch.summaryZh: 也门胡塞武装发布了一段视频，声称展示了其对沙特支持的也门政府军发动的无人机袭击。该视频旨在展示其军事打击能力。
watch.whyImportant: 此类袭击进一步破坏了也门脆弱的停火局势，增加了地区冲突升级的风险。

items.title: Can China’s dancing robots swing some new business partners in Africa?
items.summary: At events marking China’s National Day in Africa on October 1, robots provided the entertainment. In Luanda, Angola, dancing robots amused guests and ambassador Zhang Bin called the industry “a small snapshot of the Chinese economy’s move towards innovation and higher-quality development”. In Brazzaville, Congo, nearly 400 guests – including Congolese officials and Chinese business representatives – watched on as a robot dog performed. Guests also interacted with a robot dog at a Chinese New...
items.titleZh: 中国的跳舞机器人能否在非洲开拓新商机？
items.summaryZh: 在非洲举行的中国国庆庆祝活动中，跳舞机器人和机器狗成为焦点，展示了中国制造业的创新成果。中国外交官借此强调了中国经济向高质量发展转型的趋势。
items.whyImportant: 通过科技展示，中国正试图在非洲市场推广其高科技产品并加强双边经贸合作。

items.title: 127 arrested as Hong Kong police bust Vietnamese-led loan-sharking syndicate
items.summary: Hong Kong police have arrested 127 people in a six-month undercover operation against a Vietnamese-led crime syndicate accused of running loan-sharking rackets charging interest rates of up to 3,700 per cent, as well as illegal gambling and unlicensed bars in West Kowloon. The syndicate is also alleged to have helped illegal immigrants find shelter and work, with police raiding eight premises on October 8 and 9. Among those arrested were 10 alleged core members, including the suspected leader, a...
items.titleZh: 香港警方破获越南裔高利贷团伙，127人被捕
items.summaryZh: 香港警方经过六个月的卧底行动，捣毁了一个由越南裔主导的犯罪团伙。该团伙涉嫌经营高利贷、非法赌博及无牌酒吧，并协助非法移民寻找住所和工作。
items.whyImportant: 此次大规模执法行动有效打击了涉及非法移民及高利贷的跨境犯罪活动，维护了社区治安。

items.title: Twelve killed and 300 injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
items.summary: Donald Trump evaluating whether US should join Saudi strikes against the Iran-backed Yemeni rebels The latest attack on the international airport in Saudi Arabia’s capital of Riyadh killed 12 people and injured more than 300 others, civil aviation authorities said early Sunday, with some in a critical condition. A Saudi-led coalition blamed Iran-backed Houthi rebels in neighbouring Yemen. A missile struck a King Khalid international airport complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights, a regional official said, speaking on condition of anonymity because they weren’t authorised to speak to the media. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 沙特首都利雅得机场遭袭，造成12人死亡、300人受伤
items.summaryZh: 沙特首都利雅得的哈立德国王国际机场遭到导弹袭击，导致12人死亡，300多人受伤，部分伤者情况危急。沙特领导的联军指责也门胡塞武装发动了此次袭击。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击加剧了沙特与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势，并引发了关于美国是否应介入冲突的讨论。

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith attends Canberra event honouring Australian troops who served in Afghanistan
items.summary: Anthony Albanese speaks at Australian War Memorial event commemorating 25th anniversary of country’s involvement in the conflict Anthony Albanese has honoured Australian troops who served in Afghanistan, using the 25th anniversary of the country’s involvement in the conflict to describe their heroism as a fight for “who we are as a people”. The prime minister joined hundreds of veterans, family members and dignitaries at a commemoration of the start of the campaign in Canberra on Sunday, with nation’s most decorated living soldier and accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith among the crowd at the Australian War Memorial. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 本·罗伯茨-史密斯出席堪培拉活动，纪念在阿富汗服役的澳大利亚军队
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯在堪培拉举行的纪念活动上，向在阿富汗服役的澳大利亚士兵致敬，称赞他们的英勇表现。备受争议的退伍军人本·罗伯茨-史密斯也出席了此次纪念澳大利亚参与该冲突25周年的活动。
items.whyImportant: 该活动旨在纪念澳大利亚的军事历史，但因涉嫌战争罪的罗伯茨-史密斯的出席而引发了公众关注。

items.title: Hurricane Isaias kills four, leaves 650,000 without power in Florida
items.summary: Four people died after Hurricane Isaias made landfall early on Saturday, and about 670,000 residents in Florida, Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi were still without power as the storm weakened to a post-tropical cyclone, according to local authorities and electricity monitoring services. Two of the deaths resulted ‌from trees falling on homes, according to local media and authorities. Authorities in Florida had received no search and rescue requests shortly after landfall in a sign of limited...
items.titleZh: 飓风“伊萨亚斯”造成4人死亡，佛罗里达州65万人断电
items.summaryZh: 飓风“伊萨亚斯”登陆后已减弱为后热带气旋，但仍造成4人死亡。佛罗里达州及周边地区约67万人受灾断电，部分死亡事故由树木倒塌引发。
items.whyImportant: 此次飓风对美国东南部基础设施造成了严重破坏，并引发了对灾后救援和电力恢复的关注。

items.title: Who rules Negeri Sembilan? Royal row tests Malaysia’s constitutional order
items.summary: The dust has yet to settle in Malaysia’s Negeri Sembilan, where a royal row has led to the fall of a state government and left the public wondering who, exactly, is in charge. Observers warn that the months-long constitutional crisis could create ripple effects well beyond the state’s borders, testing the entire nation’s systems of monarchy and government. The dispute centres on which of two men: the incumbent, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir, or his intended replacement, Tunku Nadzaruddin Tuanku...
items.titleZh: 谁在统治森美兰州？王室纠纷考验马来西亚宪政秩序
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚森美兰州因王室内部纠纷导致州政府倒台，引发了关于谁拥有实际统治权的宪政危机。观察人士警告，这场争端可能对马来西亚的君主立宪制度产生深远影响。
items.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了马来西亚地方政治与王室权力之间的潜在冲突，对国家的宪政稳定性构成了挑战。

items.title: Two Carlton players treated in hospital after needing care for ‘separate circumstances’
items.summary: Club issues brief statement about Lachie Cowan and Will Hayward, saying latter suffered minor cut to head after a fall Carlton football club has said two of its players, Lachie Cowan and Will Hayward, required treatment in hospital on Sunday morning in “separate circumstances”. The club released a statement on Sunday after reports in several media outlets that unnamed players had been taken to hospital by ambulance after a night out. Guardian Australia contacted Carlton seeking comment on the reports. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 两名卡尔顿队球员因“不同情况”在医院接受治疗
items.summaryZh: 卡尔顿足球俱乐部证实，球员拉奇·考恩和威尔·海沃德因不同原因在周日早晨入院治疗。俱乐部回应了关于球员在夜间外出后被送往医院的媒体报道，并确认海沃德因跌倒导致头部轻微割伤。
items.whyImportant: 作为职业体育俱乐部，球员的健康状况和场外行为受到公众和媒体的密切关注。

items.title: Christian nationalism in Britain driven by people who seldom go to church, says report
items.summary: Research challenges the notion that the growing visibility of crosses and other symbols reflects a revival of Christianity Christian nationalism in Britain is being driven largely by people who rarely attend church and are more concerned with defending the country’s Christian heritage, according to research. The report, by the thinktank Theos, identified five different groups within the UK in a survey that looked at their attitudes to Christianity and Britishness. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 报告称英国的基督教民族主义主要由极少去教堂的人推动
items.summaryZh: 智库Theos的一项研究指出，英国基督教民族主义的抬头并非源于宗教复兴，而是由那些很少参加教会活动、更关注捍卫国家基督教传统的人所驱动。研究识别了英国社会中对基督教和英国身份认同持不同态度的五个群体。
items.whyImportant: 该研究挑战了关于宗教符号可见度增加即代表宗教信仰复兴的传统观点，揭示了文化身份认同在现代政治中的作用。

items.title: Capital punishment is surging in the US – but after Christa Pike’s botched execution, what is its future?
items.summary: Trump has used the full might of the presidency to supercharge executions, but an avalanche of mishaps has put the system’s flaws in the spotlight It took more than an hour to establish the two intravenous lines through which Christa Pike would be injected with a giant and normally lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital, and in that time she did everything she could to assist those who were attempting to kill her. “Please try here,” she said over and over again to Tennessee’s execution team, pointing to specific parts of her body where she thought they might find a vein as they repeatedly stabbed her with needles. “Please try here, I think it will be OK. Please try up on my shoulder, higher.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国死刑执行激增，但在克里斯塔·派克执行失败后，其未来何去何从？
items.summaryZh: 尽管美国政府近期加大了死刑执行力度，但克里斯塔·派克在执行过程中遭遇的严重失误引发了对死刑制度缺陷的质疑。执行团队在寻找静脉注射点时多次失败，导致过程极其痛苦且漫长。
items.whyImportant: 执行过程中的失误再次引发了关于死刑人道性及制度合理性的激烈社会辩论。

items.title: How a museum masterpiece’s life-size replica sparked rare US-China collaboration
items.summary: For anyone who has visited the Chinese galleries at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, there is one work that stops them in their tracks. Stepping into Gallery 206, home to Chinese Buddhist art, visitors are met by a monumental wall – over 15 metres wide and 7.5 metres tall (nearly 50 feet by 25 feet) – covered in a Buddhist assembly so vast and majestic that it momentarily erases the Manhattan bustle outside. Here stands the Medicine Buddha, a 14th century Yuan dynasty (1279-1368)...
items.titleZh: 博物馆杰作的等身复制品如何促成美中罕见合作
items.summaryZh: 纽约大都会艺术博物馆收藏的元代药师佛壁画因其宏伟壮观而备受瞩目。为了展示这一杰作，博物馆通过与中国的合作，制作了等身复制品，促进了文化交流。
items.whyImportant: 这一合作项目展示了通过艺术保护和复制技术，美中两国在文化遗产领域可以实现积极的互动与交流。

items.title: Unsung turtle conservation heroes in Malaysia’s Sabah unite to fight poachers
items.summary: Roziah Jelali has a tip or two on catching a turtle poacher: carrying a pair of binoculars and having patience in spades are key to doing the job well. The 36-year-old Malaysian volunteer ranger once spent three months in Sabah tracking a man whom she suspected of illegally capturing protected turtles. Once thriving off the azure seas of Omadal Island in the Malaysian state, many turtles had been hunted down, killed and sold for their meat, according to conservation experts. Recounting the 2023...
items.titleZh: 马来西亚沙巴州的无名海龟保护英雄联合打击偷猎者
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚沙巴州的志愿者们通过耐心蹲守和观察，积极打击非法捕杀受保护海龟的偷猎者。当地海龟曾因被猎杀用于肉类贸易而数量锐减，保护工作对生态恢复至关重要。
items.whyImportant: 民间志愿者的参与对于保护濒危物种及维护当地海洋生态平衡具有积极意义。

items.title: Nanotechnology expert Antonio Facchetti joins HKUST from Georgia Tech in the US
items.summary: Materials scientist and chemist Antonio Facchetti, formerly of the Georgia Institute of Technology in the United States, has joined the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as a chair professor in its newly established department of materials. Facchetti, who was elected to the US National Academy of Engineering last year for his “contributions to the engineering of commercially viable electronic materials and devices”, researches semiconductors, dielectrics for thin-film and...
items.titleZh: 纳米技术专家安东尼奥·法切蒂从美国佐治亚理工学院加入香港科技大学
items.summaryZh: 美国国家工程院院士、材料科学家安东尼奥·法切蒂已加入香港科技大学，担任新成立的材料系讲座教授。他此前在电子材料和器件工程领域贡献卓著，未来将致力于相关科研工作。
items.whyImportant: 顶尖科研人才的引进有助于提升香港在材料科学领域的国际学术地位与创新能力。

items.title: Huanggang Port a ‘milestone’ for integrating Hong Kong, Greater Bay Area: John Lee
items.summary: The revamped Huanggang checkpoint is a “critical milestone” for the connectivity of the Greater Bay Area, Hong Kong’s leader has said, as the city and Shenzhen count down to its launch on Monday. Speaking at a ceremony on Sunday, Chief Executive John Lee-Ka Chiu said the Huanggang control point was a “landmark project” built and shared through the joint efforts of Hong Kong and Shenzhen. “Hong Kong unveiled its first five-year plan last month to proactively align with the national 15th five-year...
items.titleZh: 李家超：皇岗口岸是香港融入大湾区的里程碑
items.summaryZh: 香港特区行政长官李家超表示，即将启用的皇岗口岸是深港合作的标志性项目，对大湾区互联互通具有重要意义。此举旨在配合国家五年规划，进一步深化区域融合。
items.whyImportant: 新口岸的启用将显著提升深港两地的交通效率，促进大湾区内的人员与经济流动。

items.title: Paul Chan highlights 4 priorities ahead of Apec finance ministers’ meeting this month
items.summary: The Apec finance ministers’ meeting in Hong Kong this month will focus on fiscal policies that support livelihoods, digital infrastructure financing, inclusive finance and young financial talent, underlining the city’s role as an international financial centre, the finance chief said. “These four priorities are areas of strength for Hong Kong and fields in which we can make an active contribution,” Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po wrote in his weekly blog on Sunday. “Hosting the finance...
items.titleZh: 陈茂波强调本月亚太经合组织财长会议的四大优先事项
items.summaryZh: 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，即将举行的亚太经合组织财长会议将聚焦民生财政政策、数字基础设施融资、普惠金融及青年金融人才培养。他强调这些领域是香港的优势所在。
items.whyImportant: 作为东道主，香港通过设定会议议程展示了其作为国际金融中心的专业影响力。

items.title: Admission scores fall for Hong Kong physiotherapy courses amid jobs crunch
items.summary: Admission scores for physiotherapy degree programmes at three Hong Kong tertiary institutions fell by as much as 10 per cent this year compared with 2025, amid gloomy career prospects in the sector, the latest data shows. The decline prompted the professional body for physiotherapists to call on the government to halt healthcare funding cuts in the next budget, saying they had contributed to a jobs crunch in the sector. Across four institutions, 23 per cent of students admitted to physiotherapy...
items.titleZh: 受就业市场紧缩影响，香港物理治疗课程录取分数下降
items.summaryZh: 数据显示，香港三所高校的物理治疗学位课程录取分数较去年下降了10%。专业团体指出，医疗资金削减导致行业就业困难，呼吁政府在预算中予以重视。
items.whyImportant: 教育录取门槛的变化反映了相关行业就业前景的波动，引发了对医疗人才培养政策的讨论。

items.title: Denuclearising North Korea would ‘defy history’ as US, allies missed the boat
items.summary: The denuclearisation of North Korea has become an “increasingly improbable” goal and the United States and its allies should move beyond it to devote their diplomatic efforts to talks on arms limitations and crisis communication, the director of the US-based North Korean analysis website 38 North said. Recalling the 20 years since North Korea carried out its first nuclear test on October 9, 2006, Jenny Town said in a written interview that “a pivotal moment” in Pyongyang’s weapons development...
items.titleZh: 专家称朝鲜无核化已“违背历史”，美及其盟友应转向军控谈判
items.summaryZh: 美国智库专家指出，朝鲜无核化目标已变得极难实现，建议美国及其盟友将外交重点转向军备限制和危机沟通。朝鲜自2006年首次核试验以来，其武器开发已进入新阶段。
items.whyImportant: 该观点挑战了传统的对朝政策，反映了国际社会对朝鲜半岛局势长期僵持的担忧。

items.title: US opens antitrust probe into TV networks halting Trump coverage
items.summary: Department of Justice says it's investigating whether the White House press pool's decision violated antitrust laws.
items.titleZh: 美国对电视网络中断特朗普报道的行为展开反垄断调查
items.summaryZh: 美国司法部表示，正在调查白宫记者团中断特朗普报道的决定是否违反了反垄断法。该调查旨在评估媒体机构的行为是否涉及不正当竞争。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了关于媒体独立性与政府监管权力边界的广泛讨论。

items.title: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago - why are they resuming now?
items.summary: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed, but experts suggest officials are reading the country wrong.
items.titleZh: 美国公开处决已停止近一个世纪，为何现在恢复？
items.summaryZh: 五角大楼宣布将直播胡德堡枪击案凶手尼达尔·哈桑的处决过程。专家认为，政府此举可能误判了公众对恢复公开处决的接受程度。
items.whyImportant: 这一决定挑战了美国长期以来的司法伦理标准，引发了关于刑事司法透明度与人权的争议。

items.title: How the trial of murdered Australian brothers and US friend unfolded
items.summary: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".
items.titleZh: 两名澳大利亚兄弟及其美国朋友遇害案的审判过程回顾
items.summaryZh: 两年前在墨西哥遇害的两名澳大利亚冲浪者及其美国朋友的母亲表示，追究责任至关重要。该案件的审判过程引发了国际社会对跨国犯罪司法公正的关注。
items.whyImportant: 该案件凸显了在处理跨国暴力犯罪时，受害者家属对司法问责的迫切诉求。

items.title: US forces disable ship ‘attempting to run’ Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman
items.summary: US military jet strikes stern of commercial cargo ship 'without harming the crew', CENTCOM says.
items.titleZh: 美军在阿曼湾拦截一艘“试图突破”伊朗封锁的船只
items.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部表示，美军战机对一艘商用货船的船尾进行了打击，并未造成船员伤亡。该船被指试图突破伊朗的封锁线。

items.title: Japan’s Sumitomo Bakelite expands China chip packaging materials output amid AI boom
items.summary: Japanese semiconductor materials giant Sumitomo Bakelite plans to expand production of advanced chip packaging materials in China and Singapore, marking the second such announcement for its Chinese operations in less than four months as artificial intelligence drives demand for more sophisticated semiconductors. items.whyImportant: 此举反映了全球半导体供应链在人工智能驱动下，正持续向中国市场进行产能布局。

items.title: Yemen’s Houthis release video of drone attacks on gov’t forces
items.summary: Yemen’s Houthis have released drone video said to show attacks on Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.
items.titleZh: 也门胡塞武装发布针对政府军的无人机袭击视频
items.summaryZh: 也门胡塞武装发布了一段视频，声称展示了其对沙特支持的也门政府军发动的无人机袭击。该视频旨在展示其军事打击能力。
items.whyImportant: 此类袭击进一步破坏了也门脆弱的停火局势，增加了地区冲突升级的风险。
